domains.name: Physics
domains.description: Scientific study of matter, energy, space, time, motion, fields, and their interactions.

concepts.name: Spacetime
concepts.definition: A four-dimensional physical framework combining three spatial dimensions with time.

dimensions.notes: Spacetime combines three spatial dimensions with time and is therefore represented using a four-dimensional physical framework. The dimensional processing system will determine how this concept is computationally analyzed at each stage.

concepts.name: Special Relativity
concepts.definition: A theory describing space and time for inertial observers when gravitational effects are neglected.

dimensions.notes: Special Relativity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: General Relativity
concepts.definition: A theory describing gravity through the geometry of spacetime.

dimensions.notes: General Relativity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Time Dilation
concepts.definition: A relativistic effect in which elapsed time depends on relative motion or gravitational environment.

dimensions.notes: Time Dilation is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Length Contraction
concepts.definition: The relativistic change in measured length along the direction of relative motion.

dimensions.notes: Length Contraction is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Relativity of Simultaneity
concepts.definition: The principle that simultaneity of separated events can depend on the observer frame.

dimensions.notes: Relativity of Simultaneity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Worldline
concepts.definition: A curve in spacetime representing the history of an object or event.

dimensions.notes: Worldline is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Lorentz Transformation
concepts.definition: A transformation relating space and time coordinates between inertial reference frames.

dimensions.notes: Lorentz Transformation is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Motion
concepts.definition: Change in position of an object with respect to a reference frame over time.

dimensions.notes: Motion can be represented along one or more spatial coordinates and can be analyzed as a time-dependent physical process. The dimensional processing system will determine the appropriate computational representation.

concepts.name: Acceleration
concepts.definition: The rate of change of an object's velocity with respect to time.

dimensions.notes: Acceleration is a vector quantity describing how velocity changes over time. Its spatial direction and temporal evolution can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Displacement
concepts.definition: The change in position of an object from its initial position to its final position, including direction.

dimensions.notes: Displacement is a vector quantity describing the change in position between two points. Its spatial components and temporal context can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Velocity
concepts.definition: The rate of change of an object's displacement with respect to time, including its direction.

dimensions.notes: Velocity is a vector quantity describing the rate and direction of change of position. Its spatial components and temporal evolution can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Mass
concepts.definition: A measure of the amount of matter in an object and a measure of its resistance to acceleration.

dimensions.notes: Mass is a scalar physical quantity associated with the inertia of an object. Its role in dynamical systems can be analyzed across spatial and temporal contexts by the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Force
concepts.definition: An interaction that can change an object’s motion by producing acceleration or deformation.

dimensions.notes: Force can be represented as a vector with spatial components and can be analyzed as part of a time-dependent dynamical system. The dimensional processing system will determine the appropriate computational representation.

concepts.name: Energy
concepts.definition: A physical quantity that represents the capacity of a system to do work or produce change.

dimensions.notes: Energy is a scalar physical quantity associated with the state and dynamics of a system. Its spatial and temporal context can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Momentum
concepts.definition: A vector physical quantity representing the product of an object's mass and velocity.

dimensions.notes: Momentum is a vector quantity whose spatial components depend on the direction of motion and whose evolution can be analyzed over time. The dimensional processing system will determine the appropriate computational representation.

concepts.name: Work
concepts.definition: The transfer of energy that occurs when a force causes displacement of an object.

dimensions.notes: Work depends on the relationship between force and displacement and represents energy transferred through mechanical interaction. Its spatial and temporal context can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Power
concepts.definition: The rate at which work is done or energy is transferred.

dimensions.notes: Power describes the rate of work or energy transfer over time. Its spatial and temporal context can be analyzed through the dimensional processing system.

concepts.name: Position
concepts.definition: The location of an object relative to a chosen reference frame.

dimensions.notes: Position is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Distance
concepts.definition: The total length of the path traveled by an object.

dimensions.notes: Distance is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Speed
concepts.definition: The rate at which an object covers distance.

dimensions.notes: Speed is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Inertia
concepts.definition: The tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion.

dimensions.notes: Inertia is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Impulse
concepts.definition: The change in momentum produced by a force acting over a time interval.

dimensions.notes: Impulse is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Torque
concepts.definition: The rotational effect of a force about an axis or reference point.

dimensions.notes: Torque is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Angular Momentum
concepts.definition: A measure of rotational motion about a reference point or axis.

dimensions.notes: Angular Momentum is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Mechanical Equilibrium
concepts.definition: A state in which the net force and relevant net torque are zero.

dimensions.notes: Mechanical Equilibrium is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Centripetal Force
concepts.definition: The inward net force required for circular motion.

dimensions.notes: Centripetal Force is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Gravity
concepts.definition: The interaction associated with mass-energy that produces gravitational motion.

dimensions.notes: Gravity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Gravitational Field
concepts.definition: A field describing gravitational influence at each location.

dimensions.notes: Gravitational Field is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Gravitational Potential
concepts.definition: Gravitational potential energy per unit mass at a location.

dimensions.notes: Gravitational Potential is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Orbital Motion
concepts.definition: Motion of an object around another body under gravitational influence.

dimensions.notes: Orbital Motion is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Escape Velocity
concepts.definition: The minimum speed required to escape a gravitational field without further propulsion.

dimensions.notes: Escape Velocity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Wave
concepts.definition: A propagating disturbance that transfers energy and information.

dimensions.notes: Wave is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Wavelength
concepts.definition: The spatial period of a wave.

dimensions.notes: Wavelength is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Frequency
concepts.definition: The number of cycles or oscillations per unit time.

dimensions.notes: Frequency is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Amplitude
concepts.definition: The maximum magnitude of an oscillating quantity from equilibrium.

dimensions.notes: Amplitude is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Phase
concepts.definition: A quantity describing the position of an oscillation within its cycle.

dimensions.notes: Phase is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Interference
concepts.definition: The superposition of waves producing a combined pattern dependent on relative phase.

dimensions.notes: Interference is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Diffraction
concepts.definition: The spreading and interference of waves around obstacles or apertures.

dimensions.notes: Diffraction is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Resonance
concepts.definition: A strong response when a system is driven near a natural frequency.

dimensions.notes: Resonance is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Simple Harmonic Motion
concepts.definition: Periodic motion with a restoring acceleration proportional to displacement toward equilibrium.

dimensions.notes: Simple Harmonic Motion is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electric Charge
concepts.definition: A fundamental property responsible for electromagnetic interactions.

dimensions.notes: Electric Charge is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electric Field
concepts.definition: A vector field describing electric force per unit positive test charge.

dimensions.notes: Electric Field is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electric Potential
concepts.definition: Electric potential energy per unit charge.

dimensions.notes: Electric Potential is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electric Current
concepts.definition: The rate at which electric charge flows through a cross-section.

dimensions.notes: Electric Current is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electrical Resistance
concepts.definition: A measure of opposition to electric current.

dimensions.notes: Electrical Resistance is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Capacitance
concepts.definition: The ability of a system to store electric charge per unit potential difference.

dimensions.notes: Capacitance is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Magnetic Field
concepts.definition: A vector field associated with moving charges, currents, and magnetic materials.

dimensions.notes: Magnetic Field is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Magnetic Flux
concepts.definition: A measure of magnetic field passing through a specified surface.

dimensions.notes: Magnetic Flux is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electromagnetic Induction
concepts.definition: Production of electromotive force by changing magnetic flux.

dimensions.notes: Electromagnetic Induction is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electromagnetic Wave
concepts.definition: A propagating coupled electric and magnetic field disturbance.

dimensions.notes: Electromagnetic Wave is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Temperature
concepts.definition: A physical quantity characterizing the thermal state of a system.

dimensions.notes: Temperature is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Heat
concepts.definition: Energy transferred because of a temperature difference.

dimensions.notes: Heat is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Internal Energy
concepts.definition: The total microscopic energy associated with particles and interactions within a system.

dimensions.notes: Internal Energy is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Entropy
concepts.definition: A thermodynamic state quantity associated with energy dispersal and accessible microscopic configurations.

dimensions.notes: Entropy is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Enthalpy
concepts.definition: A thermodynamic state function useful for heat transfer at constant pressure.

dimensions.notes: Enthalpy is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Ideal Gas
concepts.definition: An idealized gas model with negligible particle volume and intermolecular interactions.

dimensions.notes: Ideal Gas is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Reflection

dimensions.notes: Reflection is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Refraction
concepts.definition: The change in propagation direction when a wave enters a medium with different wave speed.

dimensions.notes: Refraction is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Refractive Index
concepts.definition: A dimensionless quantity relating light speed in vacuum to phase speed in a material.

dimensions.notes: Refractive Index is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Polarization

dimensions.notes: Polarization is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Lens

dimensions.notes: Lens is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Focal Length
concepts.definition: A characteristic distance relating an optical system to its focus.

dimensions.notes: Focal Length is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum State

dimensions.notes: Quantum State is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Wavefunction
concepts.definition: A mathematical function used to represent the quantum state of a system.

dimensions.notes: Wavefunction is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Superposition
concepts.definition: A quantum state represented as a linear combination of allowed states.

dimensions.notes: Quantum Superposition is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Measurement
concepts.definition: A process producing an outcome associated with a quantum observable.

dimensions.notes: Quantum Measurement is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Uncertainty Principle

dimensions.notes: Uncertainty Principle is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Entanglement

dimensions.notes: Quantum Entanglement is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Tunneling

dimensions.notes: Quantum Tunneling is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Photon

dimensions.notes: Photon is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Superposition State

dimensions.notes: Quantum Superposition State is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Atom

dimensions.notes: Atom is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Electron
concepts.definition: A negatively charged elementary particle participating in electromagnetic interactions.

dimensions.notes: Electron is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Proton
concepts.definition: A positively charged composite particle found in atomic nuclei.

dimensions.notes: Proton is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Neutron
concepts.definition: A neutral composite particle found in atomic nuclei.

dimensions.notes: Neutron is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Atomic Nucleus

dimensions.notes: Atomic Nucleus is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Radioactivity

dimensions.notes: Radioactivity is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Nuclear Fission

dimensions.notes: Nuclear Fission is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Nuclear Fusion

dimensions.notes: Nuclear Fusion is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence

dimensions.notes: Mass-Energy Equivalence is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Physical Information
concepts.definition: A representation of distinguishable physical states that can be stored, transmitted, or processed.

dimensions.notes: Physical Information is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Information Entropy

dimensions.notes: Information Entropy is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Quantum Information

dimensions.notes: Quantum Information is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.

concepts.name: Physical Field
concepts.definition: A physical quantity represented at each point in space and potentially time.

dimensions.notes: Physical Field is represented with spatial and temporal context; dimensional processing is deferred to Phase 8.
